patch.description: Rename, reorder, archive or restore. Accounts are never deleted: archive them instead.

post.description: Parses the file, classifies every row (new / duplicate / conflict) against the account, proposes categories and checks the running balance. Stores a pending import; no transaction is written until `POST /imports/{id}/commit`. Pending previews older than 24 h are discarded when a new one is made.

400.description: Missing file or fields, not a CIC CSV export, unknown, archived or non-transactional account.

post.summary: Upload a bank export and preview it

post.description: Writes the new rows and the conflicts resolved as `import`, atomically. Unresolved conflicts are skipped. Rows stored by another import since the preview count as duplicates.

400.description: Unknown row index, resolution of a non-conflict row, unknown category.

409.description: Already committed, or the preview is outdated.

get.description: Committed and pending imports, newest first.
Includes the preview rows while the import is pending.

delete.description: A pending import is discarded. A committed import is undone: it is deleted with every transaction it wrote.

open.description: True until the single owner account has been created.

TransactionKind.description: Category group: the kind given to its transactions.

slug.description: Stable identifier referenced by seeds and imports.

kind.description: Category group: the kind given to its transactions.

RuleMatchType.description: `contains`: case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive substring of the raw label or merchant. `regex`: case-insensitive regular expression tested against the raw label and merchant.

position.description: Evaluation order: the first matching rule (lowest) wins.

matchType.description: `contains`: case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive substring of the raw label or merchant. `regex`: case-insensitive regular expression tested against the raw label and merchant.

minAmountCents.description: Inclusive lower bound on the signed amount, in cents.

maxAmountCents.description: Inclusive upper bound on the signed amount, in cents.

kind.description: Overrides the category's kind when set (e.g. `transfer` for a move to one of the user's own accounts).

merchant.description: Merchant name given to matching transactions, when set.

matchType.description: `contains`: case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive substring of the raw label or merchant. `regex`: case-insensitive regular expression tested against the raw label and merchant.

kind.description: Overrides the category's kind when set (e.g. `transfer` for a move to one of the user's own accounts).

ids.description: Every rule id, in the new evaluation order (first = highest priority).

categoryId.description: Category the user filed the transaction under.

matchType.description: `contains`: case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive substring of the raw label or merchant. `regex`: case-insensitive regular expression tested against the raw label and merchant.

kind.description: Overrides the category's kind when set (e.g. `transfer` for a move to one of the user's own accounts).

scanned.description: Transactions re-evaluated: uncategorized or categorized by a rule.

unmatched.description: Scanned transactions no rule matched (left for review).

updated.description: Transactions whose category, kind, merchant or review flag changed.

manualSkipped.description: Transactions categorized by hand, never overwritten.

matchType.description: `contains`: case-, accent- and punctuation-insensitive substring of the raw label or merchant. `regex`: case-insensitive regular expression tested against the raw label and merchant.

kind.description: Overrides the category's kind when set (e.g. `transfer` for a move to one of the user's own accounts).

AccountType.description: `checking` and `savings` are transactional (fed by imports, balance from transactions); the others are investment accounts (balance from dated value snapshots).

type.description: `checking` and `savings` are transactional (fed by imports, balance from transactions); the others are investment accounts (balance from dated value snapshots).

archivedAt.description: Set when the account is archived (closed accounts are never deleted).

balanceCents.description: Current balance in cents. Transactional accounts: running balance at the end of the latest day that has one, plus any later transaction without a balance; else the sum of all amounts. Investment accounts: latest value snapshot. Null when there is no data, or when the latest balances do not tell the end-of-day balance.

balanceDate.description: Calendar date the balance is known at (latest transaction or snapshot).

type.description: `checking` and `savings` are transactional (fed by imports, balance from transactions); the others are investment accounts (balance from dated value snapshots).

archived.description: true archives the account (kept with its history), false restores it.

file.description: Bank export (CIC CSV, Windows-1252), at most 5 MB.

duplicates.description: Rows already stored. Once committed, also counts rows that another import stored in the meantime.

conflicts.description: Probable duplicates of a transaction from another source.

issues.description: Lines that could not be parsed.

expectedCents.description: Balance the row should have had.

fromDate.description: Missing rows are between fromDate and toDate (inclusive); null for an opening mismatch.

checked.description: False when no balance could be compared.

ok.description: No gap and no opening mismatch (meaningful when checked).

openingMismatch.description: The first balance of the file does not follow the balance already stored for the previous day.

index.description: 0-based row index, referenced by the commit body.

existing.description: The stored transaction this row duplicates or conflicts with, as it was when previewed.

categoryId.description: Proposed by the rules; null when no rule matched.

needsReview.description: No rule matched: the transaction goes to the review queue.

previousBalanceCents.description: Stored balance the file continues from.

alreadyImported.description: Another committed import of this account has the same file (same SHA-256).

preview.description: Rows to review; null once committed.

ConflictAction.description: `import` keeps the row as a separate transaction, `skip` leaves it out.

action.description: `import` keeps the row as a separate transaction, `skip` leaves it out.

conflictResolutions.description: Decision for `conflict` rows. Conflicts without a decision are skipped.

categoryOverrides.description: Category chosen in the preview, replacing the proposed one (the row then leaves the review queue). Ignored for rows that are not imported.

result.description: `discarded`: a pending preview was dropped. `undone`: a committed import and its transactions were deleted.
